title: Stripe framed column
description: Section wrapper that centres content in the page column and draws the column's left and right edges as faint vertical hairlines, with an optional solid or dashed rule across the top.
notes: the side lines show from 640px up; on phones content runs to the gutter
name: stripe-frame

props.name: rails
props.description: draw the faint vertical guide lines at the column's edges (from 640px up)

props.name: rule
props.description: a hairline across the column at its top: solid, dashed or none

props.name: as
props.description: html element for the outer wrapper

props.name: className
props.description: classes for the full-width outer band (background, the dark class…)

props.name: padded
props.description: pad the column with the page gutter; turn off when rows inside need to run edge to edge

props.name: innerClassName
props.description: classes for the framed column (vertical padding…)
